purpose: Add durable module-owned Outbox, Inbox, job request, and isolation facts.
applicationCompatibility: Additive; existing applications and modules are unaffected until composition.
lockImpact: Creates a new schema and tables only; no existing application table is locked.
recovery: Restore the pre-deployment database backup only before the new tables receive authoritative facts; otherwise forward-fix.
forwardFix: Append a new migration. Never modify this migration after deployment.
